stories.title: Enforce Response Schema Contracts for Facade Outputs
stories.description: Implement strict response schema validation for evaluate_care_facade outputs to ensure consistent structure for clinical trials and provider detail flows before returning to tool_router.

stories.title: Implement Centralized Error Handling and Fallbacks in Facade
stories.description: Add standardized error handling within evaluate_care_facade to catch domain service failures, normalize error responses, and provide safe fallback messaging aligned with tool_router expectations.

stories.title: Add Facade-Level Debug Logging and Observability
stories.description: Integrate debug_logger into evaluate_care_facade to capture request inputs, orchestration steps, and outputs for clinical trials and provider detail flows, ensuring traceability for UAT and SIT.
